about: Backup and restore: the data as a .json.gz file, one CSV or an Excel file (SheetJS, loaded only on that tap); a restore only adds what is missing (@core/backup); local here until a second kind of app wants it.
docs: backup: the module is app/public/backup/index.js (buildBackup, planRestore, restore, packBackup, backupToCsv, backupToXlsx); the notes app's sheet that uses it is app/src/transfer/backup-sheet.js in the notes repo, which is the model for yours.

backup: add "xlsx$" to the external list in vite.config.mjs (it is loaded by import('xlsx') and served from vendor/), and give the app a saveRecords(list) that keeps the records' own ids (notes' addNotes) and serverCopyIn() (app-sync's sync.facts().confirmed).
